# AI Swiss Knife — Freshness-Gated Agent Router (v6.0.0-beta.1)
> Verified: 2026-11-27 | Active entries: 57 | Stale/degraded auto-excluded: 0
> Monitor-only frontier entries (research/watch-list.md) are intentionally excluded.

## Compute Worlds (`swissknife query --world <id>`)
- [cloud] Zero-Card Cloud: 1M-token context, 500B+ MoE reasoning, zero-install onboarding, and burst speech/media trials with no credit card.
- [mac] Apple Silicon Mac: Silent ~15W always-on control plane, unified-memory MLX inference (no PCIe split), and native Apple/Xcode builds.
- [gpu-pc] Discrete GPU PC (16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM): Fast CUDA prefill, hybrid sparse MoE offloading, and all heavy local image, video, and 3D generation.
- [mobile-hitl] Mobile (Human Communicator & HITL): Approval gates, voice steering, camera/share-sheet capture, and zero-port remote pings—never brute-force inference.

## Active Local Launch Recipes
- [qwen3.8-27b] (mature, primary-eval) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-IQ4_XS.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 32768 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`
- [qwen3.8-27b:mac] (mature, primary-eval) worlds:mac | mlx: `mlx_lm.server --model netprojects/Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter-MLX-6bit --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`
- [qwen3-coder-next] (mature, official-docs) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT=1 llama-server -m Qwen3-Coder-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 120000 --load-mode none --n-cpu-moe 29 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --temp 0`
- [hermes-4] (mature, vendor-claim) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `llama-server -m Hermes-4-14B-Q4_K_M.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 32768 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`
- [inkling-2-mini] (experimental, vendor-claim) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `llama-server -hf unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_M --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`
- [laya-05] (mature, official-docs) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `pip install -U laya && unsloth serve-decision convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions --port 8888`
- [qwen38-pi-lora] (mature, primary-eval) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-IQ4_XS.gguf --lora Qwen3.8-27B-pi-lora-F16.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 65536 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`
- [qwen38-super-adapter] (mature, primary-eval) worlds:gpu-pc,mac | cmd: `llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-IQ4_XS.gguf --lora Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter-F16.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 65536 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`
- [qwen38-super-adapter:mac] (mature, primary-eval) worlds:mac | mlx: `mlx_lm.server --model netprojects/Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter-MLX-6bit --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`

## Handbook Pages
- [docs/start-here-newcomer.md] Newcomer & Student Onboarding: Six essential terms, a 30-second hardware check, and three zero-paralysis first wins ($0 Cloud, Local Coding, or Local Media).
- [docs/start-here-developer.md] Seasoned Developer Fast-Track: 60-second hardware physics, harness selection leading into Pi's optional 6-rung ricing ladder, frozen-base LoRAs, and machine manifests.
- [docs/mental-model.md] How a Modern AI Stack Fits Together: A 3-minute plain-English primer explaining models, LoRA adapters, inference runtimes, safety boundaries, and agent harnesses.
- [docs/why-this-stack.md] Why This Stack (Decision Records): Transparent architectural decisions explaining why we anchor on Pi, OpenCode, Qwen3.8-27B, llama.cpp/MLX, WanGP/ComfyUI, Mobile HITL, and Tailscale—including valid exceptions and reversal triggers.
- [docs/security-and-trust.md] Security & Trust Boundaries: Three calm safety habits for newcomers and a six-boundary threat model for connecting Cloud, Mac, GPU PC, Mobile HITL, and Knowledge Vaults.
- [docs/architecture.md] How This Guide Is Maintained: Maintainer handbook: single-source in-place managed blocks, auto-discovered registry, upstream release momentum watchers, and the sync-upstream agent skill.
- [guides/pi-workshop.md] Pi Ricing Workshop (Optional 6-Rung Ladder): Progressive, 100% optional journey taking Pi Coding Agent from naked in 5 minutes to adapted local GGUF, sandboxing, smart MCP, durability, mobile HITL, and ComfyUI.
- [guides/coding-and-apps.md] Coding & Apps: End-to-end web, CLI, and Apple mobile engineering pairing verified models and harnesses with Context7 live docs, Playwright QA, MobileBuildMCP, and TDD skills.
- [guides/media-studio.md] Local Media Studio (WanGP & ComfyUI): Unified local creative pipeline separating turnkey low-VRAM generation (WanGP) from programmable agent-driven node graphs (ComfyUI + MCP), plus code motion graphics and WebGPU speech.
- [guides/memory-and-knowledge.md] Persistent Context, Memory & Knowledge Loops: Four clean layers for durable agent and personal memory using AGENTS.md/SKILL.md, Pi Durable, plain-Markdown Obsidian vaults, local qmd hybrid search, and KV-cache-stable injection.
- [guides/research-and-writing.md] Research & Writing: Cited literature synthesis combining OpenAlex academic graphs, Exa 3.0 neural search, Firecrawl Markdown extraction, and open research harnesses.
- [guides/specialist-domains.md] Specialist Domains: Upstream-federated starting stacks (max 2 direct picks + 1 monitored upstream directory) for Reverse Engineering, Game Dev & 3D, Growth & Social, and Unfiltered Local AI.
- [reference/models-and-harnesses.md] Models, Harnesses & Runtimes Reference: Scannable factual index of all verified local models, agent harnesses, inference runtimes, and safety boundaries.
- [reference/retired.md] Retired & Disqualified Tools: CI-enforced graveyard recording closed free tiers, archived extensions, and oversized models alongside their active replacements.
- [research/harness-adapters.md] Harness Adapters & In-Harness RL: Primary empirical evidence showing why lightweight per-harness LoRAs on frozen Qwen3.8-27B outperform larger unadapted checkpoints, including difficulty ablations and AutomationBench controls.
- [research/watch-list.md] 21-Day Watch List: Auto-expiring, hard-capped radar tracking frontier ceilings (monitor-only, excluded from llms.txt) and reproducible community field observations.
- [worlds/cloud.md] Zero-Card Cloud: Verified $0 credit-card-free cloud gateways, coding-agent token math, search grounding APIs, and fallback order.
- [worlds/apple-silicon.md] Apple Silicon Mac: Running a silent ~15W always-on AI control plane with Apple MLX unified-memory inference, native sandboxes, and honest media limits.
- [worlds/gpu-workstation.md] Discrete GPU PC (16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM): Understanding the Zone 1 / Zone 2 memory split, llama-server router flags, Ollama's 4K context trap, and 16GB VRAM coexistence with ComfyUI.
- [worlds/mobile-hitl.md] Mobile as Human Communicator (HITL): Using your phone strictly as a Human-in-the-Loop approval gate, voice steering surface, and capture bridge—never as a brute-force LLM runner.
- [worlds/personal-ai-fabric.md] The Personal AI Fabric: How to connect Zero-Card Cloud, Apple Silicon Mac, Discrete GPU PC, and Mobile HITL privately with zero open router ports.
